assets.label: Wind Storm
assets.subject: A powerful friendly sky-cyan swirling upward wind vortex, shaped like three broad sweeping spiral ribbons rising from a small puffy white cloud base. It lifts three small glossy balloons together: large coral-red balloon in center upper position, smaller golden-yellow balloon at left and grape-purple balloon at right, all with tiny knots and short ribbons. Two chunky mint/cyan upward chevrons embedded near the vortex make the altitude boost clear. Wind is energetic and helpful, not destructive: no lightning, damage or scary storm face. Deep blue shadows, pale icy highlights, warm balloon contrast. Compact square composition, group of balloons readable, no arrows extending out of canvas, no text or numbers.
